items.quote: We are focused on both the public and the private ecosystems, augmented by our recent acquisition of EquityZen. The objective is to cover growth companies and their employees from founding to their public maturity while broadening access for investors to the growing stack of private companies.

items.text: CFO Sharon Yeshaya explained that IPO-related flows have a tail, noting the firm understands the full cap table (including early investors and endowments) and can convert stock received at IPO through a transfer agent into a Morgan Stanley advice-based relationship, capturing wealth across the cap table.
items.quote: we have a full cap table. We understand early investors. And you can think, for example, of an endowment that might receive a stock associated with an IPO. He or she might take that and put it through from a transfer agent into a Morgan Stanley advice-based relationship.

items.text: CFO Sharon Yeshaya described the exclusive partnership with Carta, whereby Carta refers private companies and their stock plans to Morgan Stanley as they go public, creating a seamless experience and opportunities to build out relationships through that transition.
items.quote: we have an exclusive partnership with Carta, which means that they will refer those private different stock plans or different corporate companies to Morgan Stanley as they move into going public... we are committed to doing as we go through that transition is to make sure that it's a seamless experience for those clients.

items.quote: some of them may be more hidden gems like a Solium, which I thought was ingenious, that can be brought in to actually help transform where the firm is going to go with clients.
